List prompts addressed to you

Usage: bn prompt inbox [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --branch <branch>
      --to <to>                        recipient (default: resolved actor)
      --all-projects[=<all-projects>]  every project [default: false] [possible values: true, false]
      --actor <actor>                  audit actor (overrides $BN_ACTOR)
      --claimed[=<claimed>]            include prompts claimed by the selected actor even if addressed elsewhere [default: false] [possible values: true, false]
      --hub <hub>                      hub clone directory (overrides $BEANS_HUB)
      --terminal[=<terminal>]          include terminal prompts [default: false] [possible values: true, false]
      --json[=<json>]                  machine-readable JSON output [default: false] [possible values: true, false]
      --limit <limit>                  maximum prompts (0 = all) [default: 50]
      --no-fetch[=<no-fetch>]          reads: skip the throttled fetch [default: false] [possible values: true, false]
      --no-sync[=<no-sync>]            mutations: commit locally without fetching or pushing [default: false] [possible values: true, false]
      --project <project>              project name (overrides $BEANS_PROJECT and git auto-detection)
  -h, --help                           Print help
